preconditions.description: The product of the number of books and the length of each book title is at most 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s_i) == m for s_i in s)
preconditions.description: Each book title has exactly m characters.
Each book title consists of uppercase Latin letters.
All book titles are pairwise distinct.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is a valid book index between 1 and n.
All integers in the output are unique.

postconditions.expression: all(s[return_value[i] - 1] < s[return_value[j] - 1] for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n) if all(s[return_value[i] - 1][k] == s[return_value[j] - 1][k] for k in range(m) if k % 2 == 0) and any(s[return_value[i] - 1][k] != s[return_value[j] - 1][k] for k in range(m)) and (k := next(k for k in range(m) if s[return_value[i] - 1][k] != s[return_value[j] - 1][k])) % 2 == 0 and s[return_value[i] - 1][k] > s[return_value[j] - 1][k] or (k := next(k for k in range(m) if s[return_value[i] - 1][k] != s[return_value[j] - 1][k])) % 2 == 1 and s[return_value[i] - 1][k] < s[return_value[j] - 1][k])
postconditions.description: The book titles are sorted in asc-desc-ending order based on the specified rules.
